source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 658 clears OAuth objects before checking the saved login and creating the account. The test utility also clears server tokens and cached OAuth objects on teardown. Current _forgetObjects clears both token fields on live cached objects, empties their weak-reference set and clears OAuth state. This separates persisted-token checks from accidental reuse of an in-memory token. The current granular browser test retries a known authorization/verification race and asserts succeeded telemetry; that retry logic is later source, not proof that the original 658 test covered the race deterministically.
title: Discard in-memory OAuth objects when testing stored token state
